source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: الصيف الماضي، قررنا نروح عالبحر مع العيلة.
sentences.en: Last summer, we decided to go to the sea with the family.

sentences.ar: صحينا الصبح بكير وحضرنا الأكل والشراب.
sentences.en: We woke up early in the morning and prepared food and drinks.

sentences.ar: ركبنا السيارة والطريق كان طويل بس حلو.
sentences.en: We got in the car and the road was long but nice.

sentences.ar: لما وصلنا، الولاد نزلوا عالمي على طول.
sentences.en: When we arrived, the kids went into the water right away.

sentences.ar: قعدنا تحت الشمس وأكلنا بطيخ بارد.
sentences.en: We sat under the sun and ate cold watermelon.

sentences.ar: بعد الظهر، الجو صار أبرد شوي.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, the weather got a bit cooler.
We played in the sand and collected seashells.
Before we went back, we watched the sunset.
We came home tired but happy.
It was a day we won't forget.
